item.title: Limitations
item.description:
Playground

The playground has no stdin, no shell (one wctr command per line) and no networking. Ctrl-C stops waiting for a container but leaves it running. Each container is bounded: 256 MiB of memory, a 5-minute run, 64 MiB of writes, 4 MiB of logs, and 64 containers at once.

The default UI, the dashboard, makes the page slower to be ready than the terminal page (728 ms against 1070 ms in Chromium on the live site), because dashboard.wasm is 20.45 MB raw (5.32 MB gzipped). A size reduction is in progress (planned). The terminal-only page is at ?ui=terminal.

Engine

Engine v0.9.0 does not have:

  • CPU accounting: a WebAssembly guest gives none, so wctr stats shows CPU as --;

  • host-path volumes: only named volumes exist, and a host path is refused;

  • networking, exec, attach and build: no container networking, no exec, no attaching to a container (so an interactive run), and no image build; the roadmap lists them as planned;

  • a distinct quota error: when a container exhausts its storage quota, the write surfaces to the module as EIO.
